note: Posted hours found by the ROUND desk in September 2026: the place's own site or reservation page first, then its Google, Yelp or Resy listing. Sunday first. Applied to any seed entry that has none of its own. `closed` = reported permanently closed; those go to Not for ROUND.

notes.11th-street-bar: Own site prints Sat/Sun as '12:00 AM - 4:00 AM', read here as noon (12:00) given weekend match-day openings. Also opens one hour before any Liverpool FC match.
notes.angels-share: Own site confirms open from 5pm Tue-Sat and closed Sun/Mon but gives no closing time; midnight close taken from listings.
notes.banshee: Own site (banshee-nyc.com) could not be fetched; hours from an aggregator listing that mirrors the Google listing. EV Grieve's Nov 2025 pre-opening article gave slightly different planned hours (Mon-Thu 16:00-01:00, Fri 16:00-02:00, Sat 12:00-02:00, Sun 12:00-00:00).
notes.bar-primi: As of Sept 2026 the own site says 'temporarily closed for light renovations'; Yelp shows 'temp. closed' and OpenTable shows 'permanently closed'. Hours above are the site's posted schedule (lunch/brunch, aperitivo and dinner run continuously; dinner is 17:00-21:30 Sun-Thu, 17:00-22:30 Fri-Sat).
notes.bathtub-gin: Own site and Tripadvisor agree. OpenTable listing differs (Thu-Fri to 04:00, Sat 16:00-04:00, Sunday brunch 11:30-16:00).
notes.brass-monkey: Site qualifies the times as '(more or less)'.
notes.cafe-wha: Closed Mon and Tue; own site confirms house band Wed-Sun but lists no hours. Two listings agree on these times.
notes.copper-and-oak: Sources conflict: Yahoo Local says Wed-Sat 17:00-01:00 (closed Sun-Tue); Restaurantji says Thu-Sat 16:00-01:00; Time Out (older) says Tue-Sat 17:00-01:00 and Sun 14:00-22:00. Yahoo listing used as best reading.
notes.dante-west-village: Own site: open daily 10am, all-day dining until 12am Mon-Sun. One listing shows Sunday closing at 11pm.
notes.dba: Own site (drinkgoodstuff.com) could not be fetched. Tripadvisor and Time Out both give 13:00-04:00 daily; one aggregator (wheree) says 12:00 open.
notes.don-angie: Dinner span only. Bar opens 30 min before the dining room (4:30pm Mon-Thu, 3:30pm Fri-Sun); last seating 10:30pm nightly. Separate Fri-Sun lunch 11:30am-2pm not included.
notes.double-chicken-please: From the bar's own Toast ordering page; official site lists no hours.
notes.employees-only: Own site lists no hours; two listings agree on 6pm-4am daily.
notes.fairfax: All-day cafe/bar with continuous service from breakfast through dinner; span is open-to-dinner-close.
notes.fanelli-cafe: Own site (fanellicafe.nyc) only says 'Open 11am-late'; day-by-day closes taken from listing.
notes.frying-pan: Seasonal open-air venue; hours subject to weather and the season closes in autumn.
notes.grand-banks: Seasonal outdoor bar (spring-fall). Hours above are the site's in-season hours; at time of check (Sept 2026) the site banner read 'CLOSED FOR THE SEASON' while Hudson River Park's page said 'open for the season', so current status is unclear.
notes.home-sweet-home: Site states 'open until 4AM if needed'; earlier closes possible on slow nights.
notes.joyface: Own site lists the bar's address as 104 Avenue C at E 7th St (not 513 E 5th St). Saturdays the site says dance-party doors open at 17:00.
notes.jungle-bird: Own site carries three inconsistent hours blocks; used the day-by-day block matching its 'open daily at 3 pm until late' tagline. Tripadvisor agrees except it lists 14:00 opening Sat-Sun. Another block on the site shows Mon-Wed 16:00-02:00, Thu-Sat 14:00-03:00, Sun 14:00-02:00.
notes.kikis: Continuous service from noon; whole span written.
notes.le-dive: Own site lists no hours. Yahoo Local gives per-day hours (used); Dim Hour lists 16:00-02:00 daily.
notes.lucien: Own site (luciennyc.com) and OpenTable post no hours. Sources conflict: goop says Sun-Wed 12:00-00:00, Thu-Sat 12:00-01:00; nyc.com says 12:00-00:00 daily; Time Out says 11:00-00:00 daily; Tripadvisor says 11:00-02:00 daily. Lunch through dinner is continuous.
notes.lullaby: Own site lists no hours. Aggregators agree on 18:00 open; wheree lists Sun-Wed 01:00 close and Thu-Sat 02:00 close, Dim Hour lists 02:00 daily.
notes.maries-crisis: Own site says bar 4pm to close, 7 days, no closing time. Time Out lists Mon-Thu 4pm-3am and Fri-Sat 4pm-4am (no Sunday); nyc.com lists 4pm-4am daily. Sunday close assumed to match weekdays.
notes.mister-paradise: Own site and Yelp blocked; hours from an aggregator listing that mirrors the Google listing.
notes.monsieur: Own site: closed Sun & Mon, Tue 18:00-00:00, Wed 18:00-01:00, Thu-Sat '6pm - late'. The 03:00 close for Thu-Sat is from the Yahoo Local listing (https://local.yahoo.com/info-238603892-monsieur-new-york/).
notes.mr-fongs: No official site found; Yahoo Local and Restaurantji listings agree on these hours.
notes.mr-purple: Own site's hours section used; happy-hour.nyc lists later weekday opens (16:00) and a 03:00 Thursday close.
notes.mudville-9: Own site (mudvilleny.com) blocks fetching. OpenTable lists Tue 4pm-11pm, Wed-Sun 11:30am-11pm and no Monday hours, read here as closed Monday.
notes.onieals-grand-street: Mon-Sat from own site. Site omits Sunday but advertises Sunday brunch from 11:30; Sunday 11:30-02:00 taken from an older nyny.com listing, while Tripadvisor shows Sunday closed.
notes.parkside-lounge: Opening times (Mon-Thu 4pm, Fri-Sun 3pm, 'open late 7 days') from own site; 04:00 close from Restaurantji listing.
notes.pastis: Continuous service (breakfast/brunch, lunch, midday, dinner); dinner is 17:00-23:00 (Sat to 00:00).
notes.please-dont-tell: Own site (pdtnyc.com) posts no hours. Tripadvisor and goop listings agree on these hours.
notes.primos: Hotel (operator) page lists Tue-Sat only; Sun and Mon read as closed.
notes.puffys-tavern: Own site (puffystavern.nyc) blocks fetching. Third-party listings conflict (Wanderlog, Restaurantji, Tripadvisor differ on closing times; Sunday shown as 12-8PM on two of them). Best reading above.
notes.raouls: Dinner span only; Sat-Sun brunch 11:00-14:30 is a split service. Own site confirms bar opens 17:00 daily but gives no close; Michelin lists 23:00, an older nyc.com listing says 01:00.
notes.sadies-ward: Own site blocked fetching and lists no hours. Aggregators agree on Mon-Fri 17:00-04:00; whereyoueat lists Sat-Sun opening at noon, wheree lists 17:00 daily.
notes.saint-tuesday: Own site says 'open seven nights a week' but lists only live-music set times; hours above from a third-party listing verified June 2026.
notes.schmuck: Conflicting sources: damnlines listing says closed Mon, Tue-Sun 16:00-01:00 (kitchen 17:00-23:00); a Jan 2025 Cititour opening article said Tue-Sun 18:00-02:00. Own site, Yelp and Resy pages could not be read.
notes.sip-and-guzzle: Hours are for Guzzle (upstairs bar); Sip (downstairs) opens an hour later at 5pm. Own site returned rate-limit errors.
notes.smalls: Own site lists only show times, not hours. nyc.com listing says nightly 7:30pm-4am; other sources describe a first set at 7:30pm and late sessions to about 4am on weekends. Weeknight close may be earlier.
notes.smithfield-hall: Own site lists no hours. Tripadvisor listing used; the NetWaiter ordering page shows different (likely kitchen) hours: Sun 10:00-00:00, Mon-Fri 12:00-00:00, Sat 09:00-00:00. Sports bar; hours vary with match schedules.
notes.somewhere-nowhere: Own site (home and FAQ) list Wed 17:00-01:00, Thu 12:00-23:00, Fri-Sun 12:00-04:00, closed Mon-Tue. OpenTable listing differs (Thu closed, Fri-Sat 17:00-04:00).
notes.south-soho-bar: Cocktail bar hours; the dining room runs Tue-Sat 17:00-23:45 only.
notes.spring-lounge: Mon-Sat 8am-4am is consistent across Tripadvisor, nyc.com and BeerMenus; Sunday open conflicts (Tripadvisor 10am, older listings 12pm). Own site blocks fetching.
notes.standings: Own site (standingsbar.com) unreachable. Aggregator listing says Mon-Thu 17:00-01:00, Fri 17:00-02:00, Sat-Sun 12:00-02:00; Tripadvisor says Mon-Fri 17:00-02:00 with the same weekend hours. Opens earlier for big games.
notes.temple-bar: Site says Sunday is 'closed for the summer' as of September 2026; may reopen Sundays later.
notes.terra-blues: Own site gives opening times only (6:30pm Sun-Fri, 6pm Sat); closing times from a listing.
notes.terroir-tribeca: Own site (wineisterroir.com) confirms open 7 days from 4pm but gives no closing times; closing times above are from an undated Time Out listing.
notes.the-bitter-end: Own site lists no hours. Listing shows 6pm daily with 1am/2am closes; Time Out shows Sun-Thu 7:30pm-2am and Fri-Sat 8pm-4am. Conflicting.
notes.the-django: Own site gives opening times only (Mon-Sat 6:30 PM, Sun 6 PM, 'til late'); closing times from a Google-derived listing (the-django-1.wheree.com). Last sets end 12:30 AM Mon-Thu, 1:15 AM Fri-Sat, 12 AM Sun.
notes.the-grafton: Site says it regularly opens early for football/rugby matches.
notes.the-happiest-hour: Own site says closed Sun and Mon. A secondary page on the same site shows Thursday closing at 2am instead of 1am.
notes.the-standard-biergarten: Only hours block on the hotel's page is labelled 'Winter Hours'; no summer block is posted.
notes.the-tippler: Sources conflict. Own site About page: Mon-Thu 16:00-00:00, Fri-Sat 15:00-03:00, Sun 13:00-22:00. Chelsea Market directory: Sun-Thu 16:00-00:00, Fri 16:00-03:00, Sat 15:00-03:00. Tripadvisor shows only Sun-Tue 16:00-00:00 (likely stale).
notes.trailer-park-lounge: Own site (trailerparklounge.com) would not load (redirect loop). Tripadvisor and Wheree both list 16:00-02:30 daily; Restaurantji lists 16:00-02:00; an older nyc.com profile lists a noon opening.
notes.veselka: Site: Mon-Thu 9am-12am; Fri 9am then open overnight; Sat open 24 hours; Sun closes 11pm. I.e. continuously open from Fri 09:00 through Sun 23:00.
notes.von: No own site found; hours from an aggregator listing that mirrors the Google listing.
notes.walkers: Own site (walkersbarnyc.com) blocks fetching. Sources conflict: Restaurantji lists Mon-Fri 12PM-2AM, Sat-Sun 11AM-2AM; Time Out lists 'Daily 11am-1am'. Best reading above.
notes.weather-up: Own site's hours page (weatherupnyc.com/location) could not be fetched; listing above verified Aug 2026 by a third-party site.
notes.welcome-to-the-johnsons: No official site. happy-hour.nyc (verified June 2026) lists Mon-Fri 16:30-04:00, Sat-Sun 13:00-04:00; Dim Hour lists 14:00-04:00 daily. The more specific listing is used.
notes.wiggle-room: Own site lists hours only for Thursday through Saturday (8pm-4am); other days are treated as closed.
notes.wogies: Own site (wogies.com) was rate-limited; hours from a listing.
notes.wxou-radio-bar: BeerMenus and Time Out agree; one happy-hour listing shows Sunday closed.
